comment: Where Lucid's answer to a bool operand departs from the reference's, as of 2026-11-15 (LCD-1020).
This file only shrinks: a deviation that is not listed fails the sweep, and so does a listed one
that no longer deviates -- delete the entry in the commit that fixes it.
kind: over-accept (the reference refuses, Lucid answers), class (both refuse, NotImplementedError
vs a plain RuntimeError), non-runtime (Lucid's refusal is not a RuntimeError), over-refuse
owner: LCD-1020-E1 engine schema row | LCD-1020-A1 Python composite (BOOL_REFUSED row) |
out-of-batch (not in this batch) | probe-artifact (the probe varies a non-operand) |
call-dependent (the reference's class varies with the call form).
devices: omitted when both devices deviate; otherwise the one that does.
